R13 correctness review complete. 0 CRIT. 4 MAJ: (1) validate_restore_source_json type-guards enforce_admins.enabled against str only — integer 0 silently coerces to bool False, removing admin enforcement with no error or CAUTION line; fix: replace isinstance(…,str) check with not isinstance(…,bool). (2) RESTORE_CAUTION_LINES_BLOCK built prematurely at lines 840-842 before admin/required-checks CAUTION lines are appended at lines 870-882 — incomplete block is dead code since rebuild at 946-952 is authoritative, but the ordering is a latent future-edit hazard; fix: delete lines 840-842. (3) Test suite has no positive assertion that the invocation log block is emitted to stdout when the unified PUT fails (APPLY_FAIL=1) — the put_fail test at line 2439 asserts stdout contains '- **Restore mode:** yes' but not the '## Invocation log entry' log-block header that is the primary APPLY_FAIL contract; fix: change expected_stdout to '## Invocation log entry'. (4) base64 -d decode failure in wrapper content fetch (line 656) is silently treated as inaccessibility — if gh api succeeds but returns non-base64 output (rate-limit error, malformed JSON), base64 -d 2>/dev/null fails silently and || echo '' sets wrapper_content='' bypassing pin-verification without requiring --i-understand-wrapper-inaccessible; fix: separate API call exit from decode exit, hard-error on decode failure. 2 MIN: (5) workflow path '024[C-Z]*/**' includes 024G tooling slice; (6) no test for --expected-wrapper-sha without prior restore evidence (should exit 2). 1 nit: (7) D-047 rationale omits --i-understand-wrapper-inaccessible as a second bypass surface. Carry-forward closures verified: R8-CORR-001 cascade-status regex correct (anchored single-capture); R8-CORR-002 prior-entry detection guarded by RESTORE_MODE -eq 0; bootstrap defect closed via 024[C-Z]*/** path filter + tooling-slice short-circuit. R12 MAJ (CORR-MAJ-001/002/003) all closed by fix-round-12.
